'''Sedri''' was a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]], the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sedri system/Legends|Sedri system]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sedrian]]s and the [[Golden Sun]], a living [[Coral/Legends|coral]] used as a power source.

==History==
Sedri remained unnoticed by the galaxy at large for several centuries due to several facts: It was located in a void and the [[Golden Sun]] made the planet inaccessible by hyperdrive. The living coral had [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-manipulating abilities that made the planet's gravity signature appear like that of a giant star. Additionally, the coral emitted golden light that illuminated the entire planet-spanning oceans.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was represented by [[Mors Odrion]], a diplomat. He was unable to prevent a short civil war, with the Rebel-aligned High Priest being challenged by [[Karak]], who believed the Golden Sun should belong to all Sedrians. At the same time, trade opened up with the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Shortly thereafter, several Sedrian settlements were threatened by the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Limna Yith]] as she attempted to elude the pursuit of competing agents of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], including [[Ket Maliss]]. She was eventually captured here by others and delivered to [[Mal Biron]] on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].

After the [[Battle of Fitsay]], the planet joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], for which [[SedriMotors Ltd.|SedriMotors]] created [[Amphibion]]s.

Native species included the [[gweld]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Sedri in the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
